WITH config AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::integer FROM settings WHERE key = 'LANGUAGE_GATE_MAX_VIDEOS_PER_RUN'), 30) AS max_videos,
    COALESCE((SELECT (value #>> '{}')::integer FROM settings WHERE key = 'LANGUAGE_GATE_DESCRIPTION_MAX_CHARS'), 1000) AS description_max_chars,
    COALESCE((SELECT value #>> '{}' FROM settings WHERE key = 'LANGUAGE_GATE_MODEL'), 'nvidia/llama-3.3-nemotron-super-49b-v1') AS model,
    COALESCE((SELECT value #>> '{}' FROM settings WHERE key = 'LANGUAGE_GATE_PROMPT_VERSION'), 'v1') AS prompt_version,
    COALESCE((SELECT value #>> '{}' FROM settings WHERE key = 'LANGUAGE_GATE_TARGET_LANGUAGE'), 'pt') AS target_language,
    COALESCE((SELECT value #>> '{}' FROM settings WHERE key = 'LANGUAGE_GATE_TARGET_REGION'), 'BR') AS target_region
), candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT candidate.*
    FROM config
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL select_language_detection_candidates(
      config.max_videos,
      config.description_max_chars,
      CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    ) candidate
), started AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_runs (
    workflow, status, items_received, metadata
  )
  SELECT
    '01B - TrendLens - Content Language Gate',
    'running',
    (SELECT count(*) FROM candidates),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'model', config.model,
      'prompt_version', config.prompt_version,
      'target_language', config.target_language,
      'target_region', config.target_region,
      'max_videos_per_run', config.max_videos,
      'eligible', 0,
      'rejected', 0,
      'uncertain', 0
    )
  FROM config
  RETURNING id, started_at
)
SELECT
  started.id AS pipeline_run_id,
  started.started_at AS run_started_at,
  candidate.video_id IS NOT NULL AS has_candidate,
  candidate.*,
  config.model AS detection_model,
  config.prompt_version
FROM started
CROSS JOIN config
LEFT JOIN candidates candidate ON TRUE
ORDER BY candidate.published_at DESC NULLS LAST, candidate.video_id;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs
     SET finished_at = COALESCE(finished_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),
         status = CASE
           WHEN items_failed > 0 AND items_processed = 0 AND items_skipped = 0 THEN 'failed'
           WHEN items_failed > 0 THEN 'partial'
           ELSE 'success'
         END,
         duration_seconds = COALESCE(
           duration_seconds,
           EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - started_at))
         ),
         metadata = metadata || jsonb_build_object(
           'detections_completed', items_processed,
           'detections_uncertain', items_skipped,
           'detections_failed', items_failed,
           'model_calls_estimated', api_calls
         )
   WHERE id = $1::bigint
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  id AS pipeline_run_id,
  workflow,
  status,
  items_received,
  items_processed,
  items_skipped,
  items_failed,
  api_calls,
  duration_seconds,
  metadata,
  started_at,
  finished_at
FROM updated;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    $1::bigint AS run_id,
    $2::bigint AS video_id,
    $3::text AS detected_language,
    $4::numeric AS confidence
), persisted AS (
  SELECT result.*
    FROM args
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL persist_language_detection(
      args.video_id,
      args.detected_language,
      args.confidence,
      'llm_metadata',
      CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    ) result
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs run
     SET items_processed = run.items_processed + CASE
           WHEN persisted.language_eligibility IN ('eligible', 'rejected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         items_skipped = run.items_skipped + CASE
           WHEN persisted.language_eligibility = 'uncertain' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         api_calls = run.api_calls + 1,
         metadata = run.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
           persisted.language_eligibility,
           COALESCE((run.metadata ->> persisted.language_eligibility)::integer, 0) + 1
         )
    FROM args, persisted
   WHERE run.id = args.run_id
  RETURNING run.id, run.items_processed, run.items_skipped, run.items_failed, run.api_calls
)
SELECT updated.*, persisted.*
  FROM updated
  CROSS JOIN persisted;

WITH args AS (
  SELECT
    $1::bigint AS run_id,
    $2::bigint AS video_id,
    $3::text AS external_id,
    $4::text AS message,
    $5::text AS model,
    $6::text AS prompt_version
), retry_state AS (
  SELECT state.*
    FROM args
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL record_language_detection_failure(args.video_id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) state
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO pipeline_errors (
    pipeline_run_id, workflow, node, error_type, error_message,
    external_id, retry_count, metadata
  )
  SELECT
    args.run_id,
    '01B - TrendLens - Content Language Gate',
    'Persistir elegibilidade de idioma',
    'language_persistence_error',
    left(
      regexp_replace(
        args.message,
        '(?i)(authorization|api[_-]?key|token|password|secret)[^ ,;]*',
        '[REDACTED]',
        'g'
      ),
      4000
    ),
    args.external_id,
    2,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'video_id', args.video_id,
      'model', args.model,
      'prompt_version', args.prompt_version,
      'next_retry_at', retry_state.language_retry_after
    )
  FROM args
  CROSS JOIN retry_state
  RETURNING id
), updated AS (
  UPDATE pipeline_runs run
     SET items_failed = run.items_failed + 1
    FROM args
   WHERE run.id = args.run_id
  RETURNING run.id, run.items_processed, run.items_skipped, run.items_failed, run.api_calls
)
SELECT updated.*, retry_state.*, (SELECT id FROM logged) AS pipeline_error_id
  FROM updated
  CROSS JOIN retry_state;
